Appreciate any guidance,
Sara

Folks — forwarding a customer request (Aperture Labs) below. Key asks:
- Can we split the BOOTCAMP50 promotional credit amount across two customer invoices and surface an explicit line item per invoice?
- If yes, what accounting artifact do we generate (credit memo, revised invoice, journal entry) and how long will it take?
- Any legal constraints in the promo terms that would prevent reassignment across legal entities / cost centers?

Customer timeline: fiscal close Nov 15. They’re amenable to signing a short amendment if required. I attached an internal workbook to capture the flow (internal-accounting-playbook.xlsx). Please flag any compliance or revenue recognition issues.

Thanks — Connor

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Credits from BOOTCAMP50 + invoice trace — need accounting/legal guidance

Quick thoughts — we can do this operationally but there are a couple of paths:
1) Issue a credit memo equal to the promo value and generate two revised invoices allocating the credit proportionally. This is my preferred customer-facing approach (clean audit trail).
2) If legal needs a binding change, require a one-page amendment (DocuSign) that authorizes credit reallocation; then we create the accounting docs.

Dependencies: finance needs the exact amounts per team and the legal entity names (for invoice headers). If they want faster turnaround we can prioritize this as a billing queue item but it will take ~4–7 business days after sign-off to produce revised invoices.

Also note: if the promo terms restrict transfer, we’ll need the amendment signed before we touch accounting. CCing Laura for revenue recognition confirmation.

— Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:56:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Credits from BOOTCAMP50 + invoice trace — need accounting/legal guidance

Confirming Ben’s note. From a revenue recognition and audit standpoint we prefer:
- Documented customer approval (DocuSign amendment referencing promo code BOOTCAMP50 and the desired allocation)
- Internal credit memo + revised invoices issued to each legal entity with the credit line clearly labeled ("Promotional credit applied — BOOTCAMP50").

Timeline: once we receive the signed amendment and the list of entity names + allocation amounts, finance can produce the credit memo and revised invoices in 3–5 business days. If they need it faster we can accelerate but require an approval email thread that explicitly authorizes the allocation (less preferred than a signed amendment).

I'll draft the customer-facing language for the amendment and the invoice description; Connor, want me to send a draft back to you to review before you send to Aperture?

— Laura

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Patel <sara@aperturelabs.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@aperturelabs.ai>

Subject: Re: Credits from BOOTCAMP50 + invoice trace

Hi Sara / Tom — thanks for your patience. Short summary and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

1) We can reallocate the BOOTCAMP50 promotional value across multiple invoices by issuing an internal credit memo and then publishing revised invoices that each show a line: "Promotional credit applied — BOOTCAMP50".
2) We need an authorization from Aperture: either (A) a one-page amendment signed in DocuSign (preferred), or (B) an explicit confirmation email from an authorized signer. We’ve prepared a simple amendment template that references DEAL-2026-045.
3) Timeline: after we receive signed amendment + entity names and allocation amounts, finance will produce the credit memo and revised invoices in 3–5 business days. If Aperture confirms via email instead of DocuSign we can do it in 5–7 business days. We’ll prioritize to meet your Nov 15 close where possible.

Next steps for Aperture:
- Reply to this thread with the names/legal entities for Team A and Team B and the dollar allocation you prefer (or percent split).
- If you prefer DocuSign please click here: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/amendment-DEAL-2026-045 (amendment-docusign-link.txt attached)

I’ve attached the proforma revised invoice for review (revised-invoice-proforma.pdf). Ben/Laura/Irene remain on the thread for execution once we get sign-off.

Thanks — Connor
